justification: The raster fitter accepted a fit when the named streets landed on road pixels. On a figure whose road mask covers most of the image (Warringah G3 p113: white background, hairline roads, mask 0.88 after dilation) every centreline point is on road, so named_on_road is 1.0 whatever the placement, and a 426 m2 / 0.16 m/px fit passed. fit_centre now refuses when the mask covers more than 60% of the figure and records road_share in the report row. One script, one new test file; no DB, no network in the tests.

pre_impl.existing_data: data/canterbury_bankstown_precincts/fit_report_7_2.json and data/warringah_precincts/fit_report_g9.json hold the accepted fits; their source figures were re-read from the published PDFs and the mask share measured on each (C-B 7.2 sections 2-13: 0.18-0.32; G9: 0.34; G3 p113: 0.88).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed the failing G3 figure would show a high share on the raw >=249 mask; it is 0.68 raw and 0.88 after the 5x5 dilation the scorer uses, so the gate measures the dilated mask, the one the on-road scores are computed on.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One helper road_share reusing _road_mask, one constant, one refusal branch in the existing refused-row mechanism. No new module.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: The refusal is removed or the threshold moves outside the measured gap: the test asserts 0.344 < ROAD_SHARE_MAX < 0.884, and that a white-background hairline-road array and a band mask covering the whole image exceed it while a typical grey map does not.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: The published figures themselves: shares were measured on the real PDF pages (chapter-7-2-city-west.pdf, warringah-dcp-2011-full.pdf p113), not on synthetic data.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Mutation run 2026-10-20: ROAD_SHARE_MAX set to 1.5 (gate disabled) -> 3 failed / 1 passed (white-background, band-mask and threshold-range tests red). Restored to 0.60 -> 4 passed.

functions.name: road_share
functions.input: greyscale figure array and optional road_band
functions.output: fraction of pixels the dilated road mask covers, 0..1
functions.if_none: input is always an array from figure_image; an empty array would raise, loudly, rather than pass

values.read_at: measured 2026-10-20: accepted max 0.344 (G9), accepted C-B max 0.316, G3 0.884
values.if_missing: without a gate a mostly-white figure scores named_on_road 1.0 for any placement

break_it.scenario: A legitimate dense figure with a wide road band exceeds 0.60 and is wrongly refused.
break_it.what_happens: A good centre is refused, not written; visible in the report row and exit code 1.
break_it.how: Refusal is loud with the share quoted; every currently accepted figure is at most 0.344, leaving 0.26 margin.
break_it.repro: python /tmp measurement over all 13 accepted figures: max 0.344

break_it.scenario: A hairline-road white figure scores just under the gate.
break_it.what_happens: The noise fit would pass the on-road check.
break_it.how: G3 is 0.884, 0.28 above the gate; the lot-edge check still applies after the gate.
break_it.repro: road_share on G3 p113 largest image = 0.884

break_it.scenario: A figure with a road_band whose grey band is also the land fill covers most of the image.
break_it.what_happens: Refused as ambiguous: on-road scores would hold for any placement.
break_it.how: The gate measures the same band mask the scorer uses, so a band that covers >60% is refused with the share quoted; G9's band figure is 0.344 and passes.
break_it.repro: road_share(img, [222,236]) on a uniform 230 image exceeds the gate (test_band_mask_counts_only_the_band)
